Commentary.Commentary: 266 on this track is a very good one and the home side will know that. A couple of big partnerships will be required and the key will be to not lose wickets at the beginning. The top order has been firing for Pakistan, and they will hope more of the same happens in this run chase. The second innings will begin shortly.

The Men in Green would be rather disappointed. They somehow managed to get back in the game after that big Taylor-Latham partnership, but then let it slip with their inability to wrap the tail up. Conceded 50 runs in the last 5 overs. Shadab was obviously the pick of the bowlers with his 4-fer, while Afridi too bagged 4 of his own and was good as well. Just the showing from the rest in the fag end of the innings would have disappointed Sarfraz.

Now, there were two twists of sorts to come. The first one - just when it seemed like the Black Caps would get ahead, Shadab came up with an absolute beauty of an over where he scalped 3 wickets, which included Latham's. In the next one, Imad got Taylor. Pakistan would have thought the game is theirs now when the Kiwis were 210/7, but a more than useful 42-run brisk stand between Sodhi and Southee put the tourists back ahead, and then Boult added the finishing touches at the end.

A powerful end to the innings from the Kiwis. Some vital runs added by the tail to propel them past 260. On a rather slowish track, the visitors didn't exactly get off to the best of starts as they lost both their openers inside Powerplay 1. Then lost their in-form skipper not too long after. But, Taylor and Latham both took control of the situation and with their 130-run stand, brought their team back into this game. The two scored their respective fifties in the process.

SIX! What a way to finish the innings! Superb stuff from Trent Boult. The ball is full and around off, right in the slot so he just goes for it. Bangs it straight back over the bowler's head and hits the ad boards. Wow. Could prove to be all the difference in the end. NEW ZEALAND FINISH ON 266/9!
Fraction straight in line, on middle and leg, clipped behind square leg. Single to the total.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Fuller and slower on the stumps, keeps low as well, Lockie turns it away in front of square leg for a single.
Once again it's full and just outside off, driven through mid off by Trent Boult for a single.
From around the wicket, it's full around off, Ferguson drives it towards mid off and scampers to the other end.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. They pick up a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! That's a good catch from Junaid Khan out in the deep. Full length delivery coming in on the pads, Southee flicks this aerially and flat towards backward square leg. Junaid from fine leg runs to his left and takes a good catch.
Ferguson gets off the mark. Flicks this fuller ball into the leg side and takes two.
Lockie Ferguson is next in.

OUT! Sodhi departs, but not before playing an important part with the bat. Full in length around off, Sodhi looks to go big again but doesn't get under it at all. Just lofts it high towards covers where Shadab Khan takes a good catch by settling himself under it. A handy stand of 42 from 36 comes to an end.
Full ball in the slot again, lofted over the bowler's head for a double.

FOUR! The 250 is up for New Zealand. After the damage, incurred, this is a fantastic position to be in and there are still almost a couple of overs remaining. Full delivery coming in on the pads, Sodhi flicks it fine down the leg side and finds the fence.
Shaheen Afridi back on.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total. 15 runs from this over, a big one for New Zealand.
Drives this full delivery towards mid off for a single.

SIX! These two are putting on a show here. Useful runs for New Zealand. Full and attacking the stumps, Southee moves across the sticks and just plays the pick up shot. Clears the square leg boundary for another biggie.
Fuller outside off, smacked towards extra cover where Hafeez makes a good stop.
Outside off, played down to third man for a single.
SIX! That's outta here! Powerful hit from Ish Sodhi. Back of a length on off, Sodhi stands firm and heaves this over long on. Gets a lot of power behind it and clears the fence.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Drives this full delivery through to long on for one run.
Coming in on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a run.
Outside off, played to point.
Short ball, pulled away to deep mid-wicket. A single is added to the total.
Full and quick on middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Smacks this down the ground towards long on. One run taken.
Cutting back in on a back of a length, raps Sodhi on the thigh pad as he tries to work it across the line. Goes through the right side of the keeper and a leg bye is taken.
SIX! That's gone all the way! What a hit. Short ball which Sodhi picks up. Stays back and muscles the pull over square leg for a maximum.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller in length, on the fifth stump line, Ish looks to push it away but fails to do so.
Back of a length outside off, Southee taps it down on the off side and both batsmen scamper to complete the run.
Hasan Ali is back.
Wrists it down to long on and takes a single for doing so.
Full and outside off, some drift into the batsman, blocked off the front foot on the off side.
Full and straight, driven back down the track to the bowler.
Full and quick on the stumps, Southee gets forward and across before paddling it fine down the leg side for a brace.
Arm ball coming in with the arm, catches Southee on the pads as he tries to get some bat on it.
Outside off, quicker in pace, played to point.
Ish Sodhi has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Cut away again, but finds the gap on this occasion. A couple of runs taken by the batsmen.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square on the off side. Won't get any run for it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bit quicker through the air, outside off, pushed a bit square on the off side for a quick single.
Full and straight on middle and off, Southee comes on the front foot and meets it with a straight blade.
Slows it up on this occasion, a loopy ball on middle and off, Sodhi defends.
Sodhi prods forward and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Another yorker, outside off, drilled away on the off side. Straight to the fielder.
Ish Sodhi is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Ross Taylor is out of here. The Kiwis are crumbling in the death overs. Imad gets the breakthrough on his return to the attack and it's the big one. He spears a yorker on off, Taylor brings his bat down to dig it out but it goes under his bat. The stumps behind are rattled and New Zealand's set batsman is gone. The visitors are in trouble now.
Fires it full and fast on the pads, Southee clips it down to short fine leg for a single.
Darted full on middle stump, it goes off the inside edge and rolls away to mid-wicket for a single.
Imad Wasim to bowl once more.
The googly on middle and off, Southee comes forward and blocks it out.
Tim Southee walks out next.

OUT! He might not have got a hat-trick, but Shadab has his third of the over. This is exceptional bowling from the leggie. Set him up with the googly before, bowls the leg break this time. Tosses it up outside off, Colin de Grandhomme drives away from his body. The ball takes the edge and goes to first slip, where Babar Azam gets low and takes it safely. The whole complexion of the game has changed in one over.

Oh dear! Almost. That was so close. Wow. Colin de Grandhomme will be glad he got some meat on that. Bowls the wrong 'un on middle, it spins in and keeps quite low too. De Grandhomme goes back and just about gets an inside edge before the ball hits his pads.
Colin de Grandhomme is out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Make that three for Shadab Khan. This is an amazing over from the leg spinner. Henry Nicholls departs for a duck. The leg break on middle and off, turns ever so slightly and that's enough. Nicholls prods forward to defend but is struck low on the front pad. This time the umpire doesn't waste much time in raising his finger. Shadab is on a hat-trick here.
Henry Nicholls will be the next batsman in.

OUT! Shadab strikes again. Breaks the century stand and brings his team into this game again. Needed this wicket and the leggie has provided it. Nicely tosses it up on middle and off, it spins in as Tom Latham looks to flick this across the line. Misses and is hit on the back pad. Flush in front of the stumps and a loud appeal goes up. The umpire thinks long and hard, but eventually raises his finger. Second wicket of the innings for Shadab.
Looped up on leg stump, swept down to fine leg.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Some reverse for Hasan Ali. Fuller around off, Taylor looks to work it across the line but gets an inside edge back onto his pads. It falls besides him on the leg side and the batsmen cross over quickly.
Pushed away to the cover area again. Just the single this time.
On a good length, outside the line of off stump, punched square to the point fielder.
Back of a length as Hasan Ali continues from around the wicket, around off. Latham punches this on the up through covers and takes two.
FOUR! The timing on that is perfect. Full in length and outside off, Latham just opens the face slightly and drives it square through point for a boundary.
Powerplay 3 is signalled. That means a maximum of 5 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings. Also, Hasan Ali is brought back into the attack.
Goes with the spin and clips it through mid-wicket. One run to the total.
Darts a full ball outside off, Latham looks to unfurl the reverse paddle. Unfortunately for him, fails to make any sort of connection.
Leans into the full ball and pushes it through the gap in the covers for a single.
Quicker through the air from Shadab, kept out safely from the back foot.
A loopy full on the stumps, Latham crouches a little before turning away behind square leg for one.
Too full and outside off, Taylor drills it through covers before the ball can even turn. A single is taken.
Length ball outside off, some width on offer, cut hard but straight to point.
Angling across, around off on a good length, tapped down on the off side for a quick one.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Shot. Hit with authority! Short and into the body, Taylor with a little swivel pulls this hard behind square leg and finds the fence.
Pushes this full delivery towards mid off. Dot ball.

A bit risky, but good running between the wickets. Junaid switches angles and comes from over the wicket, bowls it full. Latham pushes it back past the bowler and takes off. Imam gets to the ball from mid on, sees Tom getting in his crease, so throws it at the striker's end. It's quite wayward though.
Full length delivery outside off from around the wicket, driven through mid off for a single.
Short ball, pulled away into the leg side for one.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Straighter one on middle and leg, some extra bounce for Shadab as well, Latham fails to play at it and gets struck on the thigh pad.
Spinning in on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side. Dot ball.
FOUR! Too straight in line, on the pads, Latham flicks it fine down the leg side and finds the fence as a result.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Tossed up on middle and leg, flicked away through mid-wicket for a double.
Shadab Khan is brought back on to bowl.

12 ODI fifty for Tom Latham! He's had a busy evening out there, but he's done so well. Continuing his good form away from home. Straying on the pads, it is flicked away through square leg for a single. Also, the 100-run stand comes up between these two as well.
FOUR! Edged and away! Room on offer outside off, a length delivery, Latham plays away from his body and gets a thick edge. It runs down to third man and goes across the boundary line.
Just behind a length, around off, punched down towards mid on. The timing wasn't great on that one.
Too straight in line, easy enough for the southpaw to flick it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Maintains that line around the off stump, a little full again, Tom pushes it to covers once more.
Plays this on the up. Latham pushes this fuller ball to the covers by taking a step forward.
Keeps strike with a single. Just knocks it through to long on and gets to the other end.
Finds the gap well again. It rises off the deck on a good length outside off, Latham punches it through the covers for two more.
Goes a bit square. Latham drives it through cover-point and manages to come back for the second.
Going away from around off, Ross uses the angle and just guides it towards third man for a single.
Touch fuller in length, close to the off stump, defend with a straight bat.
Angling across on a good length, Rosco attempts to cut it away but it takes the bottom edge and rolls down to third man. A couple of runs are collected.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Shortish delivery bowled on leg, it's pulled through the square leg area for a couple of runs.
Eases this full toss towards mid on. No run on this occasion.
Latham too goes down the ground, just on the other side. Drives it to long on and rotates strike.
Full length delivery, driven through mid off. Single to the total.
Bumper to begin the new spell, Tom helps the pull wide of short mid-wicket and crosses over.
Junaid Khan is brought back on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! That's a powerful hit. Dispatched from his sight. Short ball which sits up for Taylor. He hangs back and pulls it through backward square leg with a lot of power. A boundary results.
Fraction straight in line, flicked with a closed face to mid-wicket for one run.
Full and straight from Afridi, it's played back to the bowler.
Waits for the length ball to come to him. It's outside off, so he opens the face and runs it down to third man for one.
Fuller in length and outside off, Latham just pushes this to the covers and gets to the other end.
Shaheen Afridi is back on to bowl.

DRINKS BREAK. Good position for the Kiwis. 150 up with 17 overs to go. Around 5 an over from here will take them to 235-240. Say if we break it into parts - 4 an over from here till the 40th and then 7 an over in the last 10 - that makes it nearly 100. So 250-260. Just hope my math is right...
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a couple of runs.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Tight line and length, solidly defended.
Outside off, punched sweetly through the covers for a run.
Fuller and wider outside off, flayed through the covers for a single.
Dropped short, outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, punched behind point for a well-run two.
Short and outside off, Taylor cuts it hard through backward point but Babar Azam dives to his left to take some sting off the ball. Just a single. Reckon he saved three.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and down the leg side, gently paddled around the corner for a single.

HALF CENTURY FOR ROSCO! His 42nd in ODIs, 6th vs Pakistan. His wonderful 2018 continues. He is averaging more than 85 in this format. A length ball on middle, Taylor helps it through square leg and charges back for the second. Mild applause from the dressing room. They know that the job is not done yet.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Around off, Taylor drops it with soft hands to the off side and scampers off for a run.
On a length around off, punched wide of mid off for a single.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
Around off, spinning in, pushed down to long on for one.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight back for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
WIDE. Fired down the leg side, Taylor misses his flick.
Imad Wasim is back on. 3-0-16-0 so far.
Back of a length outside off, punched towards mid off.
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a run. 50-RUN STAND IS UP IN 72 BALLS.
On a length outside off, Taylor comes down the track and has a wild swing but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Around middle, helped through square leg for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Hasan Ali is back on. 3-0-15-0 so far.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! First boundary in the over! Full and on middle, Latham comes down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Fuller in lenth, pushed down to long on for a run.
Full on middle, Latham comes down the track and drives it through mid off for a run.
Full again, pushed down to long on for a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and around leg, now Latham paddles it through fine leg for a double.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
FOUR! SMOKED! Got it totally wrong. A full toss, Taylor does not spare it. Punishes that by a pull through mid-wicket. Guess who is more disappointed than the bowler.
Short and outside off, Taylor looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which is taken by the keeper.
Full on middle, gently paddled down the leg side for a single.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A touch short, punched down to long on again, for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards long on for a run.
Short on middle, punched back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle, punched towards long on for a single.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
Full again, pushed to the off side.
Fuller and around off, pushed straight to cover.
Around middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Short again, punched through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short on off, stays low, pushed towards short mid-wicket again.
On middle and leg, punched towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On middle and off, punched back to the bowler.
A little too short on that occasion, Taylor pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Comes down the track but is beaten in flight. Shadab shortens the length and Taylor is forced to defend.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, punched down the ground for a run.
Full and down the leg side, Taylor misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A little bit of halt in play. Hafeez is not too happy with his hand. While trying to take that catch, he has hurt himself. The physio is having a look at the same. All good now.
IN THE AIR... JUST SHORT! A touch short on middle, Latham pushes it uppishly towards the bowler but the ball just falls short. Hafeez looks to catch it but then gets hit on his hand.
Comes down the track and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and leg, punched down to long on for a single.
Tossed up again, driven through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
A little paddle sweep from Ross Taylor, gets it wide enough of short fine leg for a run.
Comes ahead and knocks this full ball down to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Not out! That's clipping so it's umpire's call. Latham survives. Arm ball from around the wicket, on leg, Latham comes forward to defend but the ball hits his front pad. Loud shout goes up but nothing from the umpire. Shadab speaks to his skipper, Sarfraz signals the 'T' and it's taken upstairs. Replays roll in and show the ball to be clipping the leg stump. Latham is safe, but Pakistan don't lose the review.
The DRS has been taken by Pakistan. It is for an lbw decision against Tom Latham. Is he gone?
Coming in on middle and leg, swept down towards short fine leg for one.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it full on middle and leg, Latham looks to sweep but it goes off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye is stolen.
Looped up and outside off, the leg spinner, the right-hander comes forward and drives it towards mid off.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Cramps him for room with the top spinner, close to off. Taylor can only force it to covers and get a single.
Leg break on the stumps, blocked out off the front foot.
Darts it full on middle and leg, swept to short fine leg for no run.
Turning in on middle stump, rising off the deck, Latham goes back and wrists it away on the leg side for a single.

Well what's going on here? Ross Taylor isn't exactly quite happy with Mohammad Hafeez's bowling action. He lets the umpire know. Sarfraz Ahmed is having a bit of an animated chat with the officials. Guess we'll continue.
Full and straight, driven back down the track.
Shout for a leg before, but the inside edge has saved Ross. He gets low to paddle this full ball, takes a rap on the pad, but not before the ball takes the inside edge. Good call from the umpire.
Wrists this down towards mid on. Won't get any run for it.
Taylor plays for the turn when there is none. Still adjusts in time and pushes it back down the track.
Fuller in length around off, Latham gets a leading edge safely towards covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, swept down to fine leg by Taylor for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez to roll his arm over.
FOUR! Off the mark in style. Spinning in on leg stump, Latham just goes with the spin and turns it through backward square leg. Finds the gap and that's a boundary.
Tom Latham to bat next.

OUT! GONE! The bowling change does the trick. Shadab Khan strikes in his very first over and it's the vital wicket of Kane Williamson. Bit of a soft dismissal, really. Shadab bowls a half tracker outside off, Williamson goes back and drags the pull hard aerially. Doesn't get enough height on it and hands a straightforward catch to Mohammad Hafeez at short mid-wicket. Pakistan celebrate, they know what a big wicket this is.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. Another dot.
Spinning away from around off, driven towards mid off.
Goes with the spin. Turning away from a shorter length outside off, Williamson backs away and cuts it to short third man.
Tossed up just around off, blocked off the front foot.
Shadab Khan is into the attack.
Down the ground again, this time towards long on, for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Some flight on this occasion, outside off, punched through the gap in the covers for a single.
Leans across to this one and offers a punch through covers for one.
FOUR! That's well played. Some width offered by Imad, so Taylor just uses that and the pace and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Worked away into the leg side for a single.

Drinks break. A bit of an even start from both teams. Pakistan sent both openers back via Afridi but since then, Williamson and Taylor have shored things up a bit. A lot rides on this pair now to steer the Black Caps to a comfortable position. If Pakistan can break this stand quickly, they can eat into that rather untested middle order.
Short of a good length outside off, cut away square to point but no run taken.
Touch straight in line, nudged down to fine leg for an easy run.
FOUR! That is a superb shot. Fuller length delivery on off stump, Williamson presents a straight bat and drives it beautifully past mid off for a boundary.
Bumper on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Better placement. It's timed well but to the man in the deep. Williamson cuts it through backward point but Afridi at third man moves to his right and cuts it off. Single taken.
Back of a length outside off, cut away but straight to point.
Drills this full delivery down the ground to long on and keeps strike with a single.
Comes down the track to get to the pitch and then defends.
Good, early call. Williamson taps this square on the off side. Initially both batsmen wanted the run but then decided against it.
Taylor eases this down to long off and changes ends.
Darted in again, a bit of a shorter length, punched to long off for a single.
Quicker in length and outside off, driven just wide of mid off for a run.
Marginally ahead of a length, on the fourth stump line, Williamson looks to drive this powerfully through the covers but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Works this away in front of square leg and crosses over.
Full this time, just outside off, it's driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! Put away. Shortish delivery on middle and off, Taylor picks the length up early, stands tall and muscles the pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Cutting back in on middle and off, a good length delivery, Ross Taylor guards it out safely.
Full in length and just outside off, pushed down the ground towards mid off.
Taylor slipped while playing that. Lucky it didn't cost him much. He still somehow manages to work it through backward square leg. Single collected.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Taylor drives it down the ground towards mid on and takes a single.
Darts in another quicker delivery, one more defensive shot presented in response.
Quicker one, on middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side with a sweep. No run taken.
Quicker delivery on the stumps, blocked by coming on the front foot.
Imad Wasim also comes into the bowling attack.
Fires it full and wide outside off, driven through towards sweeper cover. One run to end the over.
Walks down the track and drives, doesn't time it well enough. Finds mid off.
Pushed away towards covers. Too close to the fielder, so no run taken.
On a length on off, blocked solidly from inside the crease.
Good length ball in the off stump channel, run down to third man for an easy single.
Length delivery on middle stump, pushed softly in front of mid on. Both batsmen set off and complete the run with ease.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. That means a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Hasan Ali is introduced into the attack.
Full ball well outside off, Kane reaches forward and drives it with the full face to the mid off fielder.
Seaming away from a good length, outside off, played with soft hands towards point.
Full length delivery on the pads, flicked towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Takes the pace off this one. Bowls a slower length ball on middle, Williamson stays behind the line and wrists it through mid-wicket. It earns him a brace.
Full in length and seaming back in, clipped down towards fine leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Williamson cuts this towards point. Another misfield, this time from Shadab Khan, enables the batsmen to take a couple of runs.
Driven to mid off. A slight misfield there from Hasan Ali allows the batsmen to take two.
Shaping away from a good length, outside off, dabbed to point with the angle for nothing.
Outside off on a good length, played to point for no run.

Too straight in line, Williamson wrists this away through the mid-wicket area for a couple of runs. A slight hesitation from Kane as he comes back for the second because Sarfraz screams 'NO' and he thinks it's Taylor who's done that. No harm done eventually.
Junaid comes from around the wicket and angles in a length delivery on off, Taylor leans ahead and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Too straight in line, worked away to square leg for a single. Another successful over from Shaheen Afridi comes to an end.
Outside off on a good length, Taylor has nothing to do with that one.
Ross Taylor is the new man in.

OUT! Well, not for the inside edge, but for an lbw. When you check for these things, they always end up checking for leg before decisions as well. Pakistan will be delighted either way. Length ball coming back in off the seam, Munro hangs a straight bat out to defend. The ball goes into Sarfraz's mitts off something and there's a big appeal. The finger goes up after that but Munro reviews. Replays roll in and show there's no inside edge, but when checking for the lbw, all three reds are ticked. Bit unfortunate, but the opener will have to depart. New Zealand lose their review as well.
Review taken. Colin Munro is caught behind and given out. Munro has taken the DRS, possibly because the ball moved off the seam too much. Let's see now...
Full delivery attacking the off stump, driven right back at the bowler.
A change of bats for Colin Munro.

FOUR! Shot. Going to make Pakistan pay for that dropped chance? He seems to be in the mood at least. Munro steps out of his crease to this fuller length ball and smashes it over mid off. Clears the fielder there with ease and sends it across the boundary line.
Beaten! Good bowling. Afridi is doing a good job here. He bowls this on a length outside off and brings it back in this time, Munro looks to play at it but the ball goes past the inside edge.
Just behind a length, around off, defended down on the off side with soft hands.

FOUR! First boundary of the innings for Kane Williamson. Short and into the body, just sits up for Williamson who doesn't miss out on putting it away. Stands tall and pulls it along the carpet through square leg, beating the man in the deep.
Takes a step out of the crease on this occasion, opens the face once more and dabs it square towards point.
The Kiwi skipper stays inside his crease, opens the face of the bat and taps it down in front of point.
Angling across but it's quite close to the batsman, Williamson looks to put bat on ball, does so but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Good length ball on middle and off, guarded out safely from within the crease.
Kane drives this full delivery just wide of mid off and quickly gets to the other end. Will keep strike with that.
Cramps the batsman for room, on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for a brisk run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
FOUR! Better. More in control. Fuller in length outside off, no movement on offer this time, Colin Munro leans into the drive and caresses it through the covers for a boundary.
You've just got a life! What are you doing, Colin? Need to chill out, brother. It's full and in his arc around off, Munro looks to smash this out of the stadium but only connects with thin air.

Dropped! Afridi should have had his second. That's a big wicket missed. The tall pacer serves it full around off and there's a hint of movement away off the seam. Munro drives away from his body and the edge is drawn. It flies straight to Babar Azam at first slip who spills a simple catch. Could come back to haunt the Men in Green, big time.
Good length ball around the off stump, defended from inside the crease.
Back of a length into the body, pulled through to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Chance of a run out! Direct hit and that was gone! Williamson taps it down in front of point and both batsmen set off. Shadab is lightning quick to the ball and he has a shy at the striker's end. He misses, but had he hit, Munro was a goner. He'll consider himself lucky.
Keeps it nice and tight. Junaid pitches it on a length on middle, Williamson blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Cutting back in on middle and leg, a length ball, Colin manages to force it out in front of mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Shot. Full, outside off and right in the slot for him, Munro drives this on the up and finds the gap through extra cover for a boundary. No stopping that one. Was off the meat of the bat.
Skipper Kane Williamson is in at no.3.

OUT! GONE! First breakthrough for Pakistan. Good bowling from Afridi. Brings it in a touch closer than the previous delivery, makes it go away ever so slightly at the last moment and that does George Worker in. He pokes at it and gets an edge behind which Sarfraz pouches it with ease.
Some room offered outside off, Worker looks to cut it away but gets a bottom edge which falls behind.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, George Worker walks down the track, looking to flick but is caught high on the thigh pad.
Targets the top of the off stick, blocked firmly a bit square towards cover-point.
Better line. Keeps it close to the off, on a good length, Worker defends from within the crease.

Was there bat? No, no. It's the thigh pad. Afridi angles this in on leg, Worker looks to flick it away but misses and it brushes the pads. Sarfraz dives to his right, gets his hand to it but he can't hold on to it.
Back of a length around off, kept out off the back foot to end the over.
Brings out the short one and bangs it in short, ducked and evaded by the batsman.
Spears in a full length delivery on the stumps, driven down the ground towards mid on.
A touch short in length, close to off, Munro defensively punches it to short cover.
Short of a good length outside off, Colin Munro cuts this but finds Shadab at backward point.
Ahead of a length on middle and off, a mistimed drive is played back to the bowler.
Clips this down towards fine leg and a run is collected.

FOUR! Not exactly off the middle but it's enough to fetch him a boundary. Fullish in length on middle, Munro drives off the inner half and it goes through mid-wicket. Imam tries to chase it down but the ball wins the race to the boundary line.
Fraction straight in line, on a length, flicked through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Beaten! Landed on a good length around off, moves away slightly and it beats the outside edge of Munro's hanging bat.
Another fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Munro drives it but towards mid on.
Full in length and outside off, driven firmly but straight to the man at cover.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Another inside edge, this one comes back on the pads. Khan with a length ball around off, Worker plays at it only to drag it onto his pads.
On a length, cutting back in on middle, Colin looks to play at it but gets an inside edge which goes on the leg side. A run is taken.

FOUR! That's the thing about the Powerplay, you clear the infield and a boundary is more or less a surety. It's full and coming in on the pads, Munro just flicks this over mid-wicket. A few bounces and it goes across the rope.
Ooof! That was close. Junaid fires a yorker on off stump, it's quite accurate but Munro does well to bring his bat down in time and block it out.
Worker and New Zealand are off the mark. Length delivery outside off, Worker dabs it wide of point and gets to the other end.
Good start from Junaid. Bowls a length delivery in the channel outside off, Worker watches the ball and lets it be.
We are ready to get underway. Colin Munro and George Worker will open the innings for New Zealand. Junaid Khan will take the first new ball upfront. A slip in place for him. Here we go...

Tom Latham is seen having a chat with the enigmatic Danny Morrison. He says he's glad to be back on the field playing competitive international cricket. Wants to take the confidence from four years ago when they beat Pakistan and do well. States that he loves playing all three formats and he would like him and his team to play aggressively and show what they are made of. Reckons that the conditions in U.A.E. are obviously different so they have to adapt quickly and adjust their game accordingly. Informs that batting in any position is fine for him as long as it's in the best interest of the team.
TOSS - New Zealand win the toss and elect to bat first!

Pakistan have momentum on their side. Winning their 11th consecutive T20I series, the hosts will look to start this series on the right note. Their middle order could be a worry for them, as it has been largely untested in recent times as the top order has been doing the bulk of the scoring, so it will be interesting to see how they go if called upon. Their bowling is their biggest strength, so it will be a good battle between them and the Kiwi batsmen. The toss and other updates to come soon, hold on tight...

Hello and welcome for the ODI leg of New Zealand's tour of the U.A.E. The Black Caps lost the T20I series to Pakistan's dominance in the shortest format, but a change in formats now could produce a shift in momentum and fortunes for them. Kane Williamson was leading the charge as he always does, but he wasn't getting much support from his fellow mates. This time around, however, he will have the services of the likes of Ross Taylor, Tom Latham, Trent Boult and the hitting prowess of the all-rounder Colin de Grandhomme. The Kiwis seem better suited to this format, so things could be different.
